q1.question: Can I upgrade from Free to Pro?
q1.answer: Yes, you can upgrade to Pro at any time. All your existing data will be preserved.

q2.question: How does AI gift recommendation work?
q2.answer: AI analyzes your wishlist patterns and preferences to suggest personalized gifts. It helps you find perfect presents for birthdays, anniversaries, and special occasions.

q3.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
q3.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. You'll automatically switch to the free plan after your billing period ends.
